sonnet.problem: The opening card says the tribes have 'very large herds and flocks' and 'SO many animals.' That makes 'livestock' the obvious answer and rules out 'vineyards' and 'trade,' so the question tests nothing the baker has to reason out.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The 'DONE house hunting' joke reuses the real-estate idea from stop 1 card 3 ('REAL ESTATE TOUR'). That is the same joke idea twice in one lesson, with no new addition to count as a callback.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson. A callback is the one exception, and it adds something new.
